text: In life, you deserve what you tolerate. If someone is treating you like and you don't cut them off, you deserve it. If you have a trash job and you don't look for a better one, you deserve that job. Whatever you tolerate in life and you don't change it and you don't put your foot down and you don't work to fix the situation, you're admitting to the universe that you actually deserve it. Your life is not going to change. You're going to keep getting the same result that you keep tolerating for the rest of your life or until you decide to actually do something about it. This is a law of the universe that you have to understand. There aren't many laws of life cuz life is a game and the sooner you realize that, the sooner you can start winning at this game. But, I can guarantee you right now there is a something, whether it's in your job, in your health, your fitness, your relationships, there's something suboptimal, something that's bothering you about your life that you know should change, but you're not doing anything about it and you keep tolerating it and that's why it will not change.
